content.short: Rezolut is a Web3-focused marketing agency, crafting and driving bespoke promotional strategies.
content.description: Rezolut, founded in 2020, is a Web3 marketing and growth agency that helps enterprises thrive in the fast-evolving Web3 landscape. Offerings focus on optimization initiatives, such as strategies to increase Total Value Locked (TVL) and deepen audience engagement. The marketing approach emphasizes lead magnets, specialized funnels, and precise social media tactics to boost visibility, accelerate growth, and drive meaningful traction across multiple networks.
